text:
Supply order for Ellmere depot. Personnel: Bram, Dell, Greta, Jonah, Pia, Leon, Cora, Mira, Suri, Nils, Una, Vik, Teo, Hugo, Rafe, Wren, Kira, Ines, Ada, Opal, Finn, Esme. Wren out; Leon covering. Desk swaps: Cora/Una, Hugo/Finn, Greta/Ines, Jonah/Nils, Pia/Ines, Kira/Opal, Bram/Wren.

Issues: Lifts near loading bay, east wing, north office, print room, library annex, garden studio, harbour room are slow. North office lift slow today. East wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, north office, library annex too cold. Garden studio too cold in afternoon. Umbrellas in loading bay, garden studio, north office, east wing. Print room too cold in morning. Library annex too cold in afternoon. Rafe thinks north office too cold in evening. Hugo thinks loading bay too cold in evening. Leon thinks loading bay too cold in evening. Wren thinks print room too cold in afternoon.

Repainting: East wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, north office, library annex (noise). Print room (noise). Library annex repainting noise morning/evening. Harbour room repainting noise afternoon. Garden studio repainting noise in evening/morning.

Order items: 430 crates (480 minus 50 returned); 400 ladders.

Notes: Finn, Mira, Teo, Suri, Opal, Esme want north office/loading bay/garden studio/print room clear for visitors. Opal also wants library annex clear. Suri wants library annex clear. Nils, Hugo, Leon want specific areas clear. Ines, Leon, Rafe, Una, Dell, Ada prefer specific rooms for reviews. Wren prefers harbour room. Bram prefers loading bay/library annex. Cora prefers north office. Ada prefers print room. Leon prefers loading bay. Dell wants harbour room kept clear for visitors. Coffee machines in north office, library annex, loading bay working. North office coffee machine working again. Print room coffee machine working again. Harbour room coffee machine working again. Morning stand-up moved to library annex. Afternoon stand-up moved to print room. Evening stand-up moved to garden studio. User needs to send Esme, Mira, Opal, Vik, Kira morning meeting notes; Jonah afternoon notes. Assistant offered to draft note to Greta. Check with Kira/Hugo before morning meeting; Leon before afternoon meeting. User must send Hugo morning meeting notes. User must send Cora evening meeting notes. User must send Kira evening meeting notes. User needs to send Opal afternoon meeting notes. Mira asked if east wing is free in afternoon. Rafe asked if north office is free in afternoon. Nils asked if print room is free in afternoon. Leon asked if print room is free in evening. Finn asked if print room is free in morning. Reminders: Cora prefers north office for reviews; Mira prefers north office for reviews. Kira prefers garden studio for reviews. Bram prefers print room for reviews. User must send Bram morning meeting notes. Opal prefers east wing for reviews. User still needs to send Hugo notes from the afternoon meeting.
